scenes.headline: A WordPress core bug is under attack
scenes.say: Run a WordPress site? Hackers are attacking a bug in WordPress itself.

scenes.headline: CISA: exploited in the wild
scenes.body: Added to its known exploited list on November 3.
scenes.say: On November third, the US agency CISA confirmed that attackers are exploiting this flaw in the wild.

scenes.headline: The upgrade window is the weak spot
scenes.body: During a full core upgrade, an attacker with no account can run code.
scenes.say: The weak spot is the upgrade process. During a full core upgrade, an attacker with no account can run code on your server.

scenes.headline: attacks blocked in 24 hours
scenes.say: Security firm Wordfence says it blocked thirteen thousand and ninety-five attacks in twenty-four hours.

scenes.headline: Updating is still the fix.
scenes.body: WordPress 7.1.4, out October 28, closes this hole.
scenes.say: Analyst note: updating is still the fix. WordPress 7.1.4, out October twenty-eighth, closes this hole.

scenes.headline: Do this tonight
scenes.say: Tonight: check Dashboard, then Updates. Install the latest release. And keep automatic updates on.

scenes.headline: The security story behind the headline.
scenes.say: Sources are in the description. Follow Securidge.
